title.zh: 宣布每年 3 月 21 日为西内格罗斯省 Victorias市特别非工作假日的法案
title.en: An Act Declaring March 21 of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Holiday in Victorias City, Province of Negros Occidental
title.orig: An Act Declaring March 21 of Every Year as a Special Nonworking Holiday in Victorias City, Province of Negros Occidental
title.vi: Đạo luật tuyên bố ngày 21 tháng 3 hằng năm là ngày nghỉ lễ đặc biệt tại Thành phố Victorias, Tỉnh Negros Occidental
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติประกาศให้วันที่ 21 มีนาคมของทุกปีเป็นวันหยุดพิเศษในเมือง Victorias จังหวัด Negros Occidental
title.id: Undang-Undang menetapkan tanggal 21 Maret setiap tahun sebagai hari libur khusus di Kota Victorias, Provinsi Negros Occidental
title.ms: Akta mengisytiharkan 21 Mac setiap tahun sebagai hari cuti khas di Bandar Victorias, Wilayah Negros Occidental

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2009/ra_9613_2009.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: March 21 of every year is hereby declared a special nonworking holiday in Victorias City, Province of Negros Occidental, to commemorate the day it was converted into a component city.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
